npcRoster.name: Marcea Longvale
npcRoster.publicDescription: Marcea Longvale is a Hadozee survivor whose grief has sharpened into anger so constant that most people mistake it for her whole personality. She lost a child, a home, and any patience for speeches about hope, yet still keeps showing up when the Freeblade Veil need hands, eyes, or someone willing to say the cruel truth aloud. Marcea is difficult because she is wounded, not because she is empty; there is still love under the ash, but it bites anyone reaching for it too quickly.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Ullunor is a City in Earrorim, under Federal Republic, with moderate danger, Farming, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train, Ferry, Steamship. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Hadozee reads through the Hadozee entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Aerial, gliding primate-like explorers adapted for travel between high structures and open skies. They are adventurous, curious, and naturally inclined toward exploration. Table cues: Dexterous Feet, Glide, Hadozee Dodge; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
publicRumors: Marcea keeps a packed bag by the door and insists it is not because she expects to run again.
She knows which militia calls for help were ignored and has not forgiven a single name.
